entries.translation: Stils, ko valkā. Kultūra, ko nes sevī.
entries.note: Natural generic second person; ‘carry within.’

entries.translation: Stiel dae se dräögs. Kultuur die se mitdräögs.
entries.note: Central/Veldeke-style draft; no unified standard; local-dialect review required.

entries.translation: Lolenge oyo olataka. Mimeseno oyo omemaka.
entries.note: Mimeseno conveys lived customs/culture; fluent review advised.

entries.translation: Stilius, kurį dėvi. Kultūra, kurią nešiojiesi savyje.
entries.note: Natural; second clause means ‘carry within yourself.’

entries.translation: Stil, deen s du dréis. Kultur, déi s du mat dir dréis.
entries.note: Standard orthography; droen preserves wear/carry wordplay.

entries.translation: Muswelo ofwala. Kiluba kyosenda.
entries.note: Kiluba denotes Luba cultural identity; tone and native syntax review required.

entries.translation: Omusono gw’oyambala. Obuwangwa bw’otwala.
entries.note: Native noun-class agreement; brand-copy review advised.

entries.translation: Стил што го носиш. Култура што ја носиш.
entries.transliteration: Stil što go nosiš. Kultura što ja nosiš.
entries.note: Носиш naturally preserves wear/carry wordplay.

entries.translation: Wāween kōṇak eo aṃ. Manit eo kwōj bōk ippam.
entries.note: Modern orthography; first clause transcreated as ‘your way of dressing’; native review required.

entries.translation: നിങ്ങൾ അണിയുന്ന ശൈലി. നിങ്ങൾ ഉള്ളിലേറ്റുന്ന സംസ്കാരം.
entries.transliteration: Niṅṅaḷ aṇiyunna śaili. Niṅṅaḷ uḷḷilēṟṟunna saṃskāraṃ.
entries.note: Second clause means culture carried within.

entries.translation: Te kāhua e mau nei i a koe. Te ahurea e kawe nei koe.
entries.note: Natural active/stative contrast; fluent Māori review advised.

entries.translation: तुम्ही परिधान करता ती शैली. तुम्ही मनात बाळगता ती संस्कृती.
entries.transliteration: Tumhī paridhān karatā tī śailī. Tumhī manāt bāḷagatā tī saṃskr̥tī.
entries.note: Second clause means ‘culture you carry in your heart.’

entries.translation: Gaya yang anda pakai. Budaya yang anda bawa.
entries.note: Standard neutral Malay; direct balanced syntax.

entries.translation: Ny fomba fitafinao. Ny kolontsaina entinao.
entries.note: First clause transcreated as ‘your style of dress’; review regional register.

entries.translation: Stil li tilbes. Kultura li ġġorr.
entries.note: Concise native syntax; exact wear/carry contrast.

entries.translation: Таны өмсдөг хэв маяг. Таны тээж явдаг соёл.
entries.transliteration: Tany ömsdög khev mayag. Tany teej yavdag soyol.
entries.note: Standard Khalkha Cyrillic; ‘carry along’ signals embodied culture.

entries.translation: Aren am ekarawin. Ôbù am deden.
entries.note: Provisional ‘your dress style; carry your customs’; orthography and grammar require Nauruan review.
No defensible generic Diné bizaad expression found; Hózhǫ́ substitution rejected as culturally specific. Commission fluent Diné copy.

entries.translation: Isitayela osigqokako. Isiko oliphathako.
entries.note: South African isiNdebele relative ending -ko; native copy review advised.

entries.translation: Isitayila osigqokayo. Isiko oliphetheyo.
entries.note: Zimbabwean isiNdebele spelling and -yo relatives; native review advised.

entries.translation: Omutindo ngoka to zala. Omuthigululwakalo ngoka to humbata.
entries.note: Uses ‘cultural heritage’ for culture; Oshindonga review required.

entries.translation: तपाईंले लगाउने शैली। तपाईंले बोकेर हिँड्ने संस्कृति।
entries.transliteration: Tapāī̃le lagāune śailī. Tapāī̃le bokera hĩḍne saṃskr̥ti.
entries.note: Natural respectful second person; ‘carry as you go.’

entries.translation: Stilen du ber. Kulturen du ber med deg.
entries.note: Bere preserves wear/bear wordplay.

entries.translation: Stilen du bærer. Kulturen du bærer med deg.
entries.note: Literary-natural bære preserves wear/carry wordplay.

entries.translation: Stilen du bærer. Kulturen du bærer med deg.
entries.note: Macrolanguage has no separate written norm; Bokmål chosen as broad default.

entries.translation: Sitayilo imene mumavala. Chikhalidwe chimene mumanyamula.
entries.note: Sitayilo is established fashion usage; respectful/plural second person.

entries.translation: L’estil que pòrtas. La cultura que pòrtas dins tu.
entries.note: Classical orthography, Lengadocian-neutral; second clause means ‘within you.’

entries.translation: Gigishkigen gidoozhichigewin. Bimaadan gidinaadiziwin.
entries.note: Southwestern Ojibwe double-vowel; imperative transcreation; dialect and inflection review mandatory.

entries.translation: ଆପଣ ପିନ୍ଧୁଥିବା ଶୈଳୀ। ଆପଣ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ନେଇ ଚାଲୁଥିବା ସଂସ୍କୃତି।
entries.transliteration: Āpaṇa pindhuthibā śaiḷī. Āpaṇa sāṅgare nei cāluthibā saṃskr̥ti.
entries.note: Respectful second person; ‘carry along with you.’

entries.translation: Akkaataa isin itti uffattan. Aadaa isin baattan.
entries.note: Formal/plural gender-neutral ‘you’; native review advised for slogan cadence.

entries.translation: Стиль дарыс. Культурæ хæссыс.
entries.note: Iron standard selected; concise SOV clauses; native review advised.
